# Joseph Bankole

> Joseph Bankole is an AI engineer in Montreal, Canada. He spent ten years keeping bank systems running, the last five in payments (SWIFT, ISO 20022, ACH), and now builds and ships production AI agents and automations, and writes about the work at josephbankole.ca.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://josephbankole.ca/): who he is and what he builds.
- [Field notes](https://josephbankole.ca/blog/): essays on building with AI agents in production.
- [The BS Guide](https://josephbankole.ca/blog/the-bs-guide.html): a five-step guide to setting Claude up to handle the boring parts of a day job, with a copy-paste handover template.
- [AI news desk](https://josephbankole.ca/news/): a sourced brief on agentic commerce and payments.
- [Answers](https://josephbankole.ca/answers/): short, direct definitions, starting with [what a forward-deployed engineer is](https://josephbankole.ca/answers/what-is-a-forward-deployed-engineer/) [what agentic commerce is](https://josephbankole.ca/answers/what-is-agentic-commerce/) [how ACP and AP2 differ](https://josephbankole.ca/answers/acp-vs-ap2/) [what x402 is](https://josephbankole.ca/answers/what-is-x402/) [who is liable when an AI agent buys the wrong thing](https://josephbankole.ca/answers/ai-agent-purchase-liability/) [why AI agents use stablecoins](https://josephbankole.ca/answers/why-do-ai-agents-use-stablecoins/) [whether stablecoins pay interest](https://josephbankole.ca/answers/do-stablecoins-pay-interest/) [how merchants detect AI agents](https://josephbankole.ca/answers/how-merchants-detect-ai-agents/) [how to set spending limits for an AI agent](https://josephbankole.ca/answers/ai-agent-spending-limits/) [what Know Your Agent (KYA) is](https://josephbankole.ca/answers/what-is-know-your-agent/) [what the Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) is](https://josephbankole.ca/answers/what-is-universal-commerce-protocol/) [what Mastercard Agent Pay is](https://josephbankole.ca/answers/what-is-mastercard-agent-pay/) and [whether AI agents can shop on Amazon](https://josephbankole.ca/answers/can-ai-agents-shop-on-amazon/).
- [RSS](https://josephbankole.ca/feed.xml): the blog feed.
- [News RSS](https://josephbankole.ca/news-feed.xml): the news-desk feed.
- [@thearchv.ai on Threads](https://www.threads.com/@thearchv.ai): his AI news account, one recent AI story most days in plain English, with its sources named.

## Key essays

- [Read the feed terms before you build a news aggregator](https://josephbankole.ca/blog/rss-feed-terms-news-aggregator.html): the RSS terms of more than 50 sports publishers, read before a news aggregator launched; only ESPN's plainly allowed display on another site.
- [Web search summary dropped 3 names and cited a dead URL](https://josephbankole.ca/blog/a-search-summary-is-not-a-source.html): a search summary that dropped three names from a seventeen-member list, invented a table and returned a 404, and what to fetch before citing.
- [An agent's retraction is no more evidence than its report](https://josephbankole.ca/blog/agent-retraction-is-not-evidence.html): a verification agent said it had invented its sources, and a check of each published claim found every one true.
- [The production AI bug that was the context window](https://josephbankole.ca/blog/debugging-ai-context-window.html): two agents that failed the same way from context-window exhaustion, and the ordinary operations fixes.

## Projects

- [The ARCHV](https://thearchv.ca): an illustrated sports-history publication covering football, NFL, F1, tennis, golf and basketball, with an [iOS app on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/ca/app/the-archv/id6786508653).
